description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rendclaw Trow
When Rendclaw Trow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Rendclaw Trow enters, Blasting Station and Stalwart Successor trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Stalwart Successor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Rendclaw Trow
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
